description: List what companies restated: one alert per amendment filing that changed a statement an earlier filing reported, with the original and amended value of each changed metric and both filings' accessions. Filter by company, SEC acceptance date, statement type and materiality (paginated, latest acceptance first).

cik.description: Company CIK (digits) or ticker symbol. When omitted, alerts for every company the caller's plan covers are listed.

from.description: Inclusive lower bound on the date the SEC accepted the restating filing (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC).

to.description: Inclusive upper bound on the date the SEC accepted the restating filing (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC).

name: restatements_alerts
